name: B10-0228/2026 (PPE) – Escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action on gang violence in Haiti. It asks for more humanitarian aid, safe access for aid workers, and protection for women and children. It wants the Haitian authorities to investigate and prosecute gang crimes fairly. It also asks the European Union and its member states to help Haiti's police, curb illegal arms and money flows, and keep sanctions on gang leaders and their backers.

- The Parliament asks for more aid, police support and sanctions; no law changes.
- People affected are Haitians, especially children, women and displaced people.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, Commission and Haitian authorities.
